# Whole objects, compared by tools/mc-diff/canon.sh: each reference form
# through each kind of symbol. GNU as relocates every reference from code on
# this target, even to the label before it, and names a code label itself
# rather than its section.
#
# Three things GNU as does that rsasm does not copy are kept out, none of
# which changes what a linker makes of the object:
#
# - the addend of the last R_MSP430_SYM_DIFF in a section, which GNU as
#   writes as the subtrahend's negated value where it writes zero for every
#   other, so a difference is never the last relocation in a section here;
# - where a `.section .data` directive, which refers to `__crt0_movedata` as
#   it is read, falls among the undefined symbols, since rsasm orders those
#   by where they are relocated;
# - a number `.set` after the code that uses it, which GNU as relocates
#   against the symbol and rsasm writes into the field.
=== an undefined symbol
        .text
        movx.a  #X, r5
        movx.a  X, r5
        movx.a  &X, r5
        movx.a  X(r4), r5
        movx.a  r5, X
        movx.a  r5, &X
        movx.a  r5, X(r6)
        movx.a  X, X
        movx.a  &X, X(r5)
        movx    #X, X
        addx.b  X(r4), &X
        pushx.a X
        pushx.a #X
        rrax.a  &X
        clrx    X
        incx.a  X(r5)
        rlax    X
        mova    #X, r5
        mova    X, r5
        mova    &X, r5
        mova    X(r4), r5
        mova    r5, &X
        mova    r5, X(r6)
        bra     #X
        bra     X
        bra     &X
        calla   X
        calla   #X
        calla   &X
        calla   X(r5)
        adda    #X, r5
        cmpa    #X, r5
        suba    #X, r5
        mov     #X, r5
        mov     X, r5
        mov     #hi(X), r5
        mov     #lo(X), r5
        jmp     X
        mov     X, r5
        mov     &X, r5
        mov     #X, r5
        mov     X(r4), r5
        mov     r5, X
        mov     r5, &X
        mov     r5, X(r6)
        mov.b   X, r5
        mov.b   &X, r5
        mov     &X, X
        mov     @r4, X
        mov     X, &X
        add     #X, X(r7)
        mov     #lo(X), r5
        mov     #hi(X), r5
        jmp     X
        jz      X
        call    #X
        call    X
        call    &X
        br      X
        br      #X
        br      &X
        br      X(r5)
        push    #X
        push.b  X
        clr     X
        inc     &X
        tst.b   X(r4)
        rla     X
        rlc.b   &X
        .word   X
        .long   X
        .byte   X

=== differences of code labels
        .text
a:      nop
        nop
b:      nop
        .word   b - a
        .long   b - a
        .byte   b - a
        .word   a - b + 3
        .data
        .word   b - a
        .long   a - b
        .text
        jmp     a

=== LEB128 of differences of code labels
        .text
a:      nop
        mov     #0x1234, r5
b:      nop
        .data
        .uleb128 b - a
        .uleb128 a - a
        .sleb128 b - a
        .word   1
        .section .debug_foo, "", @progbits
        .uleb128 b - a
        .uleb128 b - a + 300
        .text
        jmp     a

        .data

        .uleb128 d - c
        .sleb128 c - d

        nop

        .data

        .data
c:      .word   1
        .text

=== the C runtime references for .data and .bss
        .text
        mov     #1, r5
        .data
        .word   1
        .bss
        .space  2

=== an empty .data and .bss
        .text
        nop
        .data
        .bss

=== the C runtime references for named sections
        .section .data.foo, "aw"
        .word   1
        .section .bss.foo, "aw", @nobits
        .space  2
        .section .lower.data, "aw"
        .word   2
        .section .either.bss, "aw", @nobits
        .space  4
        .section .upper.data, "aw"
        .word   3
        .section .upper.bss, "aw", @nobits
        .space  4
        .section .either.data, "aw"
        .word   4

=== the C runtime references for empty named sections
        .section .data.empty, "aw"
        .section .bss.empty, "aw", @nobits
        .section .rodata
        .word   1

=== a data section that is not writable
        .section .rodata
        .word   1
        .long   2

=== labels in data sections
        .data
d:      .word   1
        .word   d
        .long   d + 4
        .text
        mov     &d, r5
        mov     d, r5
        mov     #d, r5
        call    #d

=== alignment and section tails
        .text
        nop
        .balign 4
        mov     #1, r5
        .p2align 3
        ret
        .data
        .byte   1
        .balign 8
        .section .rodata
        .byte   2
        .align  2

=== code sections of other names
        .section .text.a, "ax"
a:      jmp     b
        .section .lowtext, "ax"
b:      call    #a
        mov     a, r5
        .section .init, "ax"
        br      #a
